title_en: TILT — URANUS & NEPTUNE, THE ICE GIANTS
title_ru: НАКЛОН — УРАН И НЕПТУН, ЛЕДЯНЫЕ ГИГАНТЫ
description: An interactive field guide to the ice giants: Uranus tipped 98° on its side with 42-year polar days, sunlight 369 times weaker than at Earth, Voyager 2's only visits in 1986 and 1989 and the data rates the Deep Space Network had to rebuild itself to reach, Neptune's Great Dark Spot and Triton's geysers, why getting there takes 16 years without a Jupiter swing-by, and where the proposed Uranus Orbiter and Probe stands in October 2026.
og: 98° of tilt, 42-year polar days, 21.6 kbit/s from Neptune and a 16-year Hohmann transfer: Uranus and Neptune, Voyager 2 and the Uranus Orbiter and Probe, interactive and sourced from NASA, JPL and the Decadal Survey.
brand: TILT — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
